description: Add the caissier role to all data, type, routing, auth, and configuration layers: UserRole enum, i18n keys, Firestore rules comment, LoginPage redirect, App.tsx route, UserManagement/UserForm role option, seedAccounts demo account, .env.example, and COMPTES.md. This feature has no dependency on FEAT-002 and must be done first because FEAT-002 imports UserRole.caissier.
steps: 1. src/types/index.ts — Add 'caissier = "caissier"' to the UserRole enum after 'cuisine = "cuisine"'. This is the single source of truth that all other files import.

2. src/i18n/fr.json — Add a top-level 'caissier' key: { 'dashboard': 'Tableau du Caissier', 'title': 'Espace Caissier', 'pending_orders': 'Commandes à valider', 'no_pending': 'Aucune commande en attente.' }. Add 'caissier': 'Caissier' inside the existing 'roles' block.

3. src/i18n/en.json — Add the same structure in English: { 'dashboard': 'Cashier Dashboard', 'title': 'Cashier Area', 'pending_orders': 'Orders to Validate', 'no_pending': 'No pending orders.' }. Add 'caissier': 'Cashier' to 'roles'.
4. src/pages/admin/UserManagement.tsx — Add '[UserRole.caissier]: "bg-teal-100 text-teal-700"' to the ROLE_STYLES record (currently has admin, serveur, cuisine, client).
5. src/components/admin/UserForm.tsx — Add '<option value={UserRole.caissier}>{t("roles.caissier")}</option>' inside the role <select>, after the cuisine option and before the admin option.

6. src/App.tsx — (a) Add lazy import: 'const CaissierDashboard = lazy(() => import("@/pages/caissier/CaissierDashboard"))'. (b) Add 'caissier: "/caissier"' to the roleRedirects Record in RootRedirect. (c) Add protected route block after the serveur route: '<Route element={<ProtectedRoute role={"caissier" as UserRole} />}><Route path="/caissier" element={<CaissierDashboard />} /></Route>'.
7. src/pages/LoginPage.tsx — Add 'caissier: "/caissier"' to the roleRedirects object inside handleSubmit.

8. firestore.rules — Add a comment block above the orders match rule: '// Roles that may update orders: caissier (validate/reject PENDING), cuisine (start/ready), serveur (serve/pay), admin (all)'. No rule logic changes are needed since 'allow update: if isAuthenticated()' already covers all staff roles.

9. src/seed/seedAccounts.ts — (a) Read 'const caissierPwd = import.meta.env.VITE_SEED_CAISSIER_PASSWORD as string | undefined'. (b) Add caissierPwd to the guard: 'if (!adminPwd || !serveurPwd || !cuisinePwd || !caissierPwd)'. (c) Update the error message to mention VITE_SEED_CAISSIER_PASSWORD. (d) Add a fourth DemoAccount: { email: 'caissier@placelavictoire.com', password: caissierPwd, nom: 'Caissier Demo', role: UserRole.caissier }.

11. COMPTES.md — Add caissier row to the staff table: '| Caissier | caissier@placelavictoire.com | Caissier2024! | /caissier — validation commandes |'. Add Firestore JSON doc example for caissier at the bottom of the Option B section.
acceptance_criteria: UserRole.caissier resolves without TypeScript error wherever it is imported
'npm run lint' exits 0 with no type errors after all changes in this feature
Both fr.json and en.json are valid JSON with all caissier keys present
The role select in UserForm shows Caissier as an option
COMPTES.md and .env.example document the caissier account and seed password
findings: Stub file was needed: src/pages/caissier/CaissierDashboard.tsx was created with 'export default function CaissierDashboard() { return null; }' because tsc --noEmit errors on a lazy() import whose target module does not exist on disk. FEAT-002 must replace this stub with the real implementation.
